title.zh: Hugging Face让Claude Code、Codex直接参与RL训练
title.en: Hugging Face让Claude Code、Codex直接参与RL训练

current_state.zh: Hugging Face open-sourced a Multi-harness RL training scheme that lets off-the-shelf coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode train open models directly, with tests showing multi-agent training lifts average pass rates from 42.2% to 54.2% on a 2.6B model.
